_meta.note: Baseline FORMULA catalogue + the canonical default per metric group. The baseline of a metric is a {center, spread, recency} triple that drives the personal z-score (Doc 03 §2b, κ_resp) and the mobile baseline UI. Canonical default is robust + adaptive: a rolling median/MAD for outlier resistance blended with an EWMA for responsiveness, time-of-day/context-conditioned where it matters. Alternatives are catalogued so any metric can be overridden with justification. Illustrative; re-verify (README §5.6).
_meta.output_model: Each computed baseline = {center μ, spread σ_robust (1.4826·MAD), n_effective, last_updated, confidence, drift_slope}. Personal z = (x − μ)/σ_robust; the UI 'band' = μ ± k·σ_robust; 'deviation scan' = today's z per metric; 'drift' = center over time.
_meta.minimums: A baseline is only emitted when n_effective ≥ the metric's min-history (cold-start gate); below that it falls back to the age×sex×life-stage cohort prior (D33) and is flagged 'provisional'.

rolling_mean.name: Rolling mean / SD
rolling_mean.def: μ = mean(window), σ = sd(window) over a fixed N-day window.
rolling_mean.robust: low — one bad day shifts μ and inflates σ.

rolling_median_mad.name: Rolling median + MAD
rolling_median_mad.use: default centre/spread — resists spikes (illness, travel, bad reads).

ewma.name: Exponentially-weighted moving average
ewma.def: μ_t = α·x_t + (1−α)·μ_{t−1}, α from a half-life.
ewma.use: responsiveness layer — adapts to genuine physiological shifts (training, recovery).
ewma.robust: medium — bounded by clamping x_t to a plausible band first.

robust_ewma_blend.name: Robust + adaptive (DEFAULT)
robust_ewma_blend.def: centre = blend(rolling_median, ewma_of_winsorized); spread = 1.4826·MAD; updates only with validated, de-duplicated, plausibility-passed samples.
robust_ewma_blend.use: the canonical baseline for most consumer metrics.

trimmed_mean.name: Trimmed / winsorized mean
trimmed_mean.def: drop or cap the top/bottom p% before averaging.
trimmed_mean.use: alternative to median when a smoother centre is wanted.

log_transform.name: Log-domain baseline
log_transform.def: compute centre/spread on log(x) for right-skewed metrics (HRV, glucose), back-transform for display.

seasonal_timeofday.name: Time-of-day / context conditioning
seasonal_timeofday.def: separate baselines by context (sleep vs wake HR; weekday vs weekend steps) to avoid mixing regimes.

windowed_sum.name: Windowed sum (rate metrics)
windowed_sum.def: sum over a rolling period (7-day MVPA); baseline = robust centre of the rolling sums.

windowed_index.name: Windowed index
windowed_index.def: an algorithmic index needing a minimum history (e.g. SRI over 14-30 nights).

slow_ewma.name: Slow EWMA (sparse metrics)
slow_ewma.def: long half-life EWMA for sparsely-updated metrics (VO₂max).

composite_z.name: Composite z
composite_z.def: combine sub-metric z-scores (overnight HR dip + HRV rise) into one recovery z.

ewma_deviation.name: Deviation EWMA
ewma_deviation.def: metric already a deviation-from-baseline (skin temp); EWMA-smooth the deviation.

defaults_by_group.individual: robust_median_mad + log_transform if skewed; context-conditioned if regime-dependent (BP morning vs evening).
defaults_by_group.derived: robust_ewma_blend on the derived series; per-device when the algorithm diverges (sleep stages, recovery scores).
defaults_by_group.frequency: windowed_sum with a partial-window guard, then robust centre of the windowed totals.
